name: SessionScope
roles: Application Security Engineer I · Software Engineer, Security
headline: A login is only the beginning.
description: Inspect the checks that bind a session to its origin, lifetime, and authorized action.
guide: Run the CSRF case with mismatched tokens. Then make them equal in the request JSON and rerun.
Choose expiry and move now to the expiration boundary. Equality must be rejected.
Run local HTTP tests for session rotation, CSRF enforcement, revocation, and signed-token validation.
limits: The public view is a session-policy simulator, not an identity provider. The local server uses real random session IDs and signed tokens. External OIDC/SSO is not implemented.
